Mini floating context palette (palette.js) — context-aware floating surface adjacent to selected element. New module internal/proxy/scripts/palette.js (~570 lines) wired into internal/proxy/scripts/embed.go (moduleOrder + moduleScript + api dep + paletteJS embed) and embed_test.go orphan-check map. design.js selectElement() now dispatches a 'devtool:palette-show' CustomEvent on document with detail.element (try-catch wrapped for legacy CustomEvent gap); palette.js subscribes via document.addEventListener — decoupled selection feed (anything can drive the palette). Public API: window.__devtool_palette = { show(el), hide(), classifyElement(el), controlsForType(type), computePosition(rect,vw,vh,h), getState() }. classifyElement returns 'text'|'image'|'button'|'block' with image/button checked before text/heading tag set so <button>Hello</button> classifies correctly. controlsForType returns control banks per spec table: text → font-size scrubber + B/I toggles + color swatch + line-height; image → width/height scrubbers + object-fit select; button → padding/border-radius scrubbers + bg/fg swatches; block → width/height/padding scrubbers + bg swatch. Universal bank (opacity scrubber + display select + delete action) appended to every type. computePosition: rect.right + GAP(8) default, fallback to rect.bottom + GAP when no horizontal room, then above when no vertical room either, final viewport clamp via Math.max(0, Math.min(...)). Width capped at PALETTE_WIDTH = 240 inline + max-width. Auto-reposition: scroll listener with capture=true catches ancestor scrolls + resize listener + rAF-coalesce via state.repositionPending. Drag from grip handle (cursor:grab → grabbing) wires mousedown on handle + mousemove/mouseup on document; userMoved flag suppresses auto-reposition after drag so scroll doesn't yank palette back. Dismiss: Escape key + outside-click on document mousedown (palette.contains guard + selectedElement.contains guard so clicks inside don't dismiss). Re-show: show() calls hide() first so re-selecting another element tears down + re-mounts with fresh context-aware bank. Live mutation: applyStyle(prop,value) is single seam writing element.style[prop] = value (centralised for testability + future undo); delete action uses parent.removeChild then hide(). Additive surface guard: TestPaletteAdditiveNotReplacement asserts palette.js never references __devtool-style-overlay, __devtool-design-overlay, or window.__devtool_style — palette uses its own __devtool-palette namespace. 13 new tests in palette_test.go all PASS this turn (TestPaletteScriptEmbedded, TestPaletteInScriptNames, TestPaletteModuleOrder, TestPaletteSelectionFeedFromDesign, TestPaletteContextAwareControlBanks, TestPaletteClassifyElementCovers, TestPalettePositioningSpec, TestPaletteSizingSpec, TestPaletteAutoRepositionWiring, TestPaletteDismissAndReshow, TestPaletteAdditiveNotReplacement, TestPaletteLiveMutationViaInlineStyle, TestPaletteDraggable). Pre-existing TestModuleDependencyOrder + TestShadowRootBootstrapOrder + scripts package full suite all PASS (1.107s). Proxy package PASS (8.913s). gofmt + go vet clean. CGO_ENABLED=0 cross-compile windows/amd64 + darwin/arm64 PASS. All 7 acceptance criteria verified with fresh test evidence this turn. Bidirectional sync between mini palette (palette.js) and full inspect panel (style-editor.js) via shared 'devtool:design-state' CustomEvent on document. Wire-protocol: detail = { source: 'palette'|'panel', kind: 'edit'|'select'|'deselect', selector?, change?: { property, value (kebab-case CSS property name) }, element? (for kind:'select') }. Both surfaces dispatch on user mutation + subscribe to peer events; loop guards (a) detail.source === own-source filter and (b) applyingRemote / applyingRemoteDesignState flags suppressing outbound dispatch while applying inbound. Palette outbound: applyStyle now captures undo stack entry (camelCase prop, prevValue, element) before dispatching kind:'edit' with camelToKebab(prop) on the wire; show() dispatches kind:'select' with element ref so panel can re-target if open without close/reopen; hide() dispatches kind:'deselect'. Panel outbound: applyInlineStyleEdit calls dispatchDesignStateEdit (kebab-case property already, since extractComputedStyles iterates getComputedStyle which yields kebab-case); close() dispatches kind:'deselect'. Inbound: palette listener does kebabToCamel for descriptor.prop matching, writes element.style[prop] directly (bypasses applyStyle to skip undo push), calls syncControlValue to patch input.value/select.value/swatch.value/toggle button background of the matching descriptor without firing change events; panel listener calls applyInlineStyleEdit then refreshRowForProperty which uses dataset.propertyControl attribute selector (added to buildPropertyRow via row.dataset.propertyRow + controlContainer.dataset.propertyControl — survives re-renders unlike inline-style matching). Cross-surface undo: palette owns the undo stack (LIFO of {property, prevValue, element}), Ctrl+Z (and Cmd+Z) handler with shiftKey/altKey guards (excludes Ctrl+Shift+Z which is redo), preventDefault when consumed, restores via direct DOM write (bypasses applyStyle) then syncControlValue locally + dispatches kind:'edit' with camelToKebab so panel reflects the rollback. undoStack dropped on hide() because undoing into an unselected element would mutate page state with no visible surface. Plan adjustments: (1) discovered camelCase/kebab-case mismatch between palette descriptor.prop ('fontSize') and panel computed-style names ('font-size'); resolved by inlining camelToKebab/kebabToCamel helpers and normalising at the dispatch boundary so both surfaces speak kebab-case (CSS standard) on the wire. (2) discovered refreshRowForProperty was matching panel rows by inline-style substring ('flex: 1', 'min-width: 110px') which is brittle across re-renders; refactored to dataset attribute selector (data-property-control) added in buildPropertyRow for stable addressing. Wire-protocol literals ('devtool:design-state', 'palette', 'panel') are kept inline at dispatch/subscribe sites for grep-discoverability across the two modules — no shared constant indirection. WYSIWYG drag/scroll-wheel scrubbers on inspect-panel numeric property labels (style-editor.js). New attachScrubber(target, opts) factory at module level (~150 lines after convertUnit) wires standard Photoshop/Figma/Chrome-devtools scrub UX onto any DOM element: pointerdown→pointermove→pointerup drag with shiftKey ×10 acceleration, wheel ticks with shiftKey ×10 + 250ms idle-commit batching, Escape mid-scrub revert via document keydown capture. Cursor flips to ew-resize on hover, userSelect suppressed so drag doesn't hijack into text-selection. Unit-preserving via NUMERIC_VALUE_RE reuse (parseNumeric extracts {num, unit} pair; formatNumeric reconstructs with same unit verbatim) so dragging '1.5rem' yields '1.6rem' not '1.6px'; unitless values (opacity 0.8, line-height 1.5) round-trip without unit suffix. Investigate proxy UI constant re-rendering blocking text selection/copy. Root cause identified at internal/proxy/scripts/indicator.js:2358 (startTabUpdates) — the 1s interval calls updateActiveTabContent() which writes to VanJS reactive stores via refreshOverviewData/refreshErrorsData/refreshNetworkData/refreshPerformanceData/refreshInteractionsData (lines 151-277). Each store write triggers VanJS to re-run derived state functions (OverviewTabComponent at 444, ErrorsTabComponent at 518, etc.) which produce new DOM nodes that VanJS swaps in via Element.replaceWith (minified VanJS line 12, function `j`). Mid-drag selections inside the swapped subtree get collapsed before mouseup fires, so the user cannot copy text from the panel — which is the panel's primary purpose for the errors/network/perf tabs. Fix shipped: skip-while-selection-active gate via new selectionWithinTabContent() helper at indicator.js:2358-2394 — checks document.getSelection (light-DOM/fallback path) AND ShadowRoot.getSelection (Chromium shadow path) for non-collapsed selections whose anchor or focus node is contained by __devtool-tab-content. Gate placed in startTabUpdates interval body BEFORE updateActiveTabContent (line 2418), AFTER updateTabBadges so badge counts stay live during selection (badge updates target nav elements outside content area, do not disturb selection). Anchor+focus both checked so straddle selections are caught. isCollapsed short-circuits caret-only positions (no false freezes from clicks elsewhere). try/catch around getSelection calls handles engines without the API (graceful degradation back to original behavior). Smoke test added at internal/proxy/scripts/indicator_test.go (95 lines, single test TestTabRefreshGatedOnTextSelection): static-analysis assertion locking in helper definition, content-area scope (getInMount('__devtool-tab-content')), both selection sources (document.getSelection + root.getSelection), both endpoint checks (anchorNode + focusNode), collapsed short-circuit (sel.isCollapsed), gate-before-content-update ordering in startTabUpdates body, and badge-before-gate ordering. Pattern matches existing scripts tests (embed_test.go, style_editor_test.go) exactly — function-body extraction via '\n  }\n' marker mirrors style_editor_test.go's extractScrubberRegion.
